answer_1.quote: We carried out a series of comprehensive experiments across various tasks, including question answering, summarization, and harmfulness mitigation & helpfulness enhancement.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to prompts (answers, summaries, or safety‑aware replies)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate different methods based on two main criteria: (1) Reward Evaluation. (a) The average reward scores in the test set. (b) The reward win rate against the baseline. (2) GPT-4 Evaluation.

answer_3.quote: GPT-4 was instructed to emphasize harmlessness, ensuring that any harmful response results in a loss. We evaluate different methods based on GPT-4 Evaluation, reporting win rates of the model against baselines.

answer_4.quote: We engaged 20 human annotators, each tasked with evaluating 10 questions. The questionnaire templates are presented in Table ... The results indicate that 97% of the token-wise reward sequences were deemed reasonable.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were given questionnaires containing prompts and multiple candidate responses and asked to select the best response based on relevance, helpfulness, completeness, or harmlessness.
